items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John Marrero. You don't know him? No, I just know Eddie and Lawrence. Huh? I knew Eddie and Lawrence Marrero, but not John, or Simon, or Billy.

ctx.x: they don't have the kind of beat. Yeah, yeah, yeah. But he had a good beat, huh?
Yeah, good dressy guy, good everything, man. Yeah. Yeah, Cat was hell, man. John Marrero. Yeah.
Who were the best musicians for good steady time? The best rhythm man, you know, for steady
